s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive umbilical discomfort with a firm, ulcerated nodule and associated abdominal mass
salient_findings: Firm, ulcerated nodule at the umbilicus
Poorly defined, firm mass in the right hypochondrium
key_facts: 10-month history of umbilical discomfort
Firm nodule at the umbilicus that gradually increased in size
Umbilical lesion became ulcerated and tender
Umbilical lesion measured 6 cm by 6 cm
Lesion bled on contact
Deep palpation revealed a firm mass in the right hypochondrium
Mass approximately 8 cm in diameter
Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma
Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT showed homogeneously enhancing umbilical tissue growth
Irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon
Total colonoscopy revealed no endoluminal lesion
